messages.content:
Translate ALL clauses into an explicit binary integer linear program.
Return ONLY one JSON object. Exactly these five keys:
formulation, variables, sense, objective, constraints.

- formulation is "binary_ilp": every variable is binary.
- variables lists every item index: [0,1,2,...,n-1], no repetitions.
- sense is "max".
- objective is the explicit list of the input weights, one coefficient per variable.
- constraints is a list of MATHEMATICAL STRINGS, one inequality or equality each.
Use variable symbols x0,x1,...,x(n-1) and actual integer coefficients.
Write every term explicitly. No sum(), ellipsis, prose, solution, refusal or extra key.

Rules for individual clauses:
exclusion [i,j] -> "xi+xj<=1" with the actual indices.
budget b -> sum(cost_i*xi)<=b, expanding ALL n terms and actual costs.
minimum l items -> sum(xi)>=l; maximum u items -> sum(xi)<=u.
required item i -> "xi==1"; forbidden i -> "xi==0".
if i selected implies j selected -> "xi-xj<=0".
Do not confuse weights (objective) and costs (budget).
Read the whole original request and include every stated clause.
Even an infeasible problem needs its full model.

Illustrative format: n4, weights[4,2,3,5], costs[2,1,2,3],
exclusion[0,2], budget4:
{"formulation":"binary_ilp","variables":[0,1,2,3],"sense":"max","objective":[4,2,3,5],"constraints":["x0+x2<=1","2*x0+1*x1+2*x2+3*x3<=4"]}

Use actual n, weights, costs, exclusions and constraints from the next input.

{"intention": "The planning file is C16-4. There are 7 entries indexed from 0 to 6. Assign a binary x_i to every entry, with x_i=1 exactly when entry i is selected. Maximize the sum of the selected weights. Every pair in edges is an incompatibility: never select both of its endpoints. Entry 4 is compulsory. These are all the requirements; impose no additional restriction.", "data": {"n": 7, "weights": [36, 52, 53, 33, 29, 34, 21], "costs": [29, 21, 22, 14, 22, 15, 24], "edges": [[1, 6]]}}
